transcript: I visited the home of the teacher Who had guided me during my university years It had been ten years He was the person whom students of my generation Had respected most He lived in an old house which had a quiet garden The figure who appeared at the door looked much older than before Yet his eyes were the same as long ago In his study, thousands of books stood on the shelves Among them were some manuscripts that he himself had written He recommended one book to me, saying, This is the book which I wanted you to read when you were young The book that I had wanted to read turned out to be exactly this one He served me tea with the same gentleness that he had shown when I was his student. What I discovered was a bundle of letters from scholars with whom he had been corresponding for many years. Those letters were the source of his wisdom
